title: AtlasMind Lens live service endpoints
description: The databases and APIs a lens may reach to compare a declared schema against the one actually served. This file is committed: it names a stored secret with `secretRef` and must never contain a token, password, or connection string. AtlasMind reads shape only — never a row, never a value — and never writes.

label.description: Shown on every surface, and the exact text you must type to confirm a probe of a production endpoint.

kind.description: `http-openapi`: the URL points at the schema document, not the API root. `graphql`: the introspection endpoint. `database`: reached through a connected MCP server — AtlasMind bundles no database driver and stores no database credential.

stage.description: An endpoint that does not state its stage is treated as production, and asks you to type its label before every probe.

url.description: Absolute https URL. Plaintext http is accepted only on the loopback address, because a probe may carry a bearer token. Credentials embedded in the URL are refused. Omit for a `database` endpoint.

mcpServerId.description: Required for `database`. The connected MCP server whose schema-reading tool should be asked. A server exposing only a generic query tool is not used: AtlasMind will not compose SQL.

secretRef.description: The name of a key in VS Code SecretStorage holding a bearer token or API key. This is a name, never a value — a document containing an actual credential is refused whole.

expectedContractIds.description: Repository contract ids this endpoint is expected to serve. An id that no longer resolves is reported as a dead end rather than dropped.
